notes.title: v1.1.0 VISUAL UPDATE + MAINTENANCE
notes.notes:
It's been awhile, but it's time for another update, version 1.1.0. Just Act Natural is getting some polish! We're working on cleaning up the menus and making it easier to find the games and settings you want. Now you can more easily filter game modes, change advanced options, and there's even a search bar to help find your friends' games. Going forward we look to get back on track with regular bi-weekly / monthly content updates. As always, Discord is the best place to make suggestions, report bugs and get in contact with the dev-team. Click HERE to join.


Few items of the changelog:

 Fixed BOLT crashing screen on startup
 Fixed default region miss-matches
 Region handling improvements
 User Interface Improvements
- Session browser
- Lobby interface
- Settings menu
 Under the hood stuff
- New data management system (cross-platform compatibility)
- Codebase refactoring
- Pipeline improvements


Thank you for your continued patience. We hope to bring you Just Act Natural to more platforms soon!!

- Lee (current captain)

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.78
notes.notes:
Hey guys! v1.0.78 is out now! Focused on fixing glitches for this update, but in addition we added the ability to kick players mid-match 🙂

So this update includes some major changes behind the scenes to the xp system(kinda why this update took so long to get out). We needed to do this to combat the cheating and fix some of the issues associated with the xp progress. Unfortunately it saves on a different system than before so you'll notice some of your progress will be wiped. Don't freak out yet though, we're working on some stuff this week to get your previous xp back in some form but there's still stuff that will need to be reset. The good news is this system is much more sustainable and we just needed to bite the bullet once and now what we got is a lot better for the long term continued development of Just Act Natural 😄

I hope you understand! ❤️

- Conor

notes.title: An Important Update On Our Monetization Plans!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. Wanted to give you an update on our monetization plans.

We’ve seen some push back, and after thinking about it all month, we’ve decided to make it so **ALL PLAYERS WILL HAVE ACCESS TO NEW MAPS/MODES IF THE HOST IS PREMIUM**. We think right now it’s better for everyone if we make everything as accessible as possible.

“Wait but me and my friends already bought the paid version! Is it just worthless now as long as we have one of us with premium?!? :angry: Gamer angry!” : so premium version still gets you the cosmetic stuff like it does now, as well as the future cosmetic stuff in the works(seeker skins, unlockable outfits, etc). Does that sound good?

All of this will be going into effect next *Friday, Oct 1st*. The game will remain $5, because of this change we may change it to $10 at version 1.0, but idk that’s still several months away so we’ll see. 

Thanks for everyone’s feedback and patience this last month, I'm new at this business stuff. But I feel this is the best way forward for everyone :) I hope you agree!

xoxox

-Conor

notes.title: Just Act Natural Premium Version Out Now!!
notes.notes:
Alright! The time has come! The Just Act Natural Premium Version is now available!

https://i.imgur.com/GKDbUde.gif

Featuring 3 New game modes, the new Castle map, and access to all the additional content that will be added the next few months!

In ASSASSINS all players are HIDERS and must find and kill the other players without revealing themselves.

https://i.imgur.com/wixjY2e.gif

In DEATH RACE Hider players must race each other to the finish line without being too eager and revealing themselves to the Seeker above!

https://i.imgur.com/dVkGWcz.gif

In addition, this version launches with PARTY MODE, which combines all the game modes together randomly!

Finally, the new hand-sculpted CASTLE stage has been added. Walk around as knights and wizards hiding from the Seeker placed in the MIDDLE of the stage!

https://i.imgur.com/XS1ttjY.gif

The Premium Version can be downloaded as DLC on the main page :D

Few changes from our original plans due to your feedback:

>Originally we were gonna have free players be on a separate server from premium players. After thinking about it some more, we decided to just have all players on one server. Realistically the premium player base may be small at the start, and we didn’t want to punish those who are supporting development by not being able to find games on the premium server. So how it works is you just wont be able to play any premium content if there are players in the party who don’t have premium, but premium players can join any lobby freely.

In addition, Lee and I are now able to do marketing efforts for the game to get new players in. That said, I’m gonna be honest, it might be a little bumpy at first. As we add more and more to this game I think we’ll get more and more premium players, but you may have to rely on this discord to set up premium matches at first. Not sure exactly what to expect, but just keep that in mind 

Thanks to everyone in this community for supporting development thus far :) You guys are seriously the best, I hope you’re as excited for the future of this game as we are!

I love you xoxoxoxoxo

-Conor

notes.title: Update Version 0.3.0 - Donkeys, Join Game Mid-Match, QOL Updates, Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/xr2sMbZ.gif

Okay! Hi! It’s been a while! Thanks for being so patient! We got a bunch of highly requested quality of life features and (most importantly) donkeys!


Biggest Added Features
-Resolution Options
-Join a game mid-match[BETA](you no longer need to wait until they return to lobby to join!)
-Spawn as fun alternatives to humans on various stages!
-In game score screen(open at any time with TAB)
-Equipped Items are saved between matches
-Option to set the desired amount of Ammo for the seeker(up to unlimited)
-Cleaner and updated UI

We have also fixed most of the current reported bugs(you can see the full detailed list on our  Trello Board). I understand that there’s been a lot of difficulty with connecting to matches/ your friends. We’ve added more detailed error messages, but from what we can tell most of the cause is trying to connect to a match when the server is at its limit. Right now we can only have 100 people online at any point, and we are going over that pretty often, which I frankly didn’t think would happen for a while. Especially on weekends, we have 200-300 playing online(which means more than half wont be able to connect o_O) which is super frustrating I'm sure. Lee and I are figuring out how to monetize the game so that we can afford to upgrade our servers. We’ll share our ideas probably tomorrow and we can figure out what’s best together . Thanks for your patience with it guys.

notes.title: JAN v0.2 OUT NOW! New Stage, Bug Fixes, QOL upgrades!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/QjL1i1A.gif

HELLO EVERYONE! We have just released the long awaited version 0.2.0! There’s quite a lot of improvements and changes. Here’s some of the bigger ones:

>New Stage[Beta]: Sushi City. 
>Hiders can now see each other in-match
>Control mapping options
>New Lobby that allows everyone to see who’s readied up, allows the host to kick players, has a chatbox and region display
>”AMMO” for the seeker that no longer allows Seeker to just keep shooting everything
>A LOT of bug fixes :) (thanks for your reports!)

Most of the work was under the hood, we restructured everything to make bug fixes a lot smoother in the future and in the process removed a lot of the bugs that have been reported. That said, it might’ve caused some new bugs to pop up. Be sure to let us know in the coming days if you find anything and we’ll get right on it :)

Thanks for your continued support. We know it’s been hard to find matches, once we get things a little more stable and add more content we’ll focus more on marketing to get new players in :)
